titleEn: Find the Divisibility Array of a String
title: 找出字符串的可整除数组
summary: 数字字符串的每个前缀若能被 m 整除则对应位置记一，否则记零，返回全部标记。
insight: 无需构造可能溢出的前缀整数。若旧余数为 r，追加数字 d 后的新余数就是 (10r+d) mod m；滚动维护余数即可。
pitfalls: 前缀可能远超整数范围
答案位置 i 对应包含 word[i] 的前缀

solutions.title: 滚动维护前缀余数
solutions.idea: 逐位利用十进制余数递推。
steps: 若 remainder 为零则 answer[i]=1

code.java: class Solution { public int[] divisibilityArray(String word,int m){int[] answer=new int[word.length()];long remainder=0;for(int i=0;i<word.length();i++){remainder=(remainder*10+word.charAt(i)-'0')%m;if(remainder==0)answer[i]=1;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun divisibilityArray(word:String,m:Int):IntArray{val answer=IntArray(word.length);var remainder=0L;for(i in word.indices){remainder=(remainder*10+(word[i]-'0'))%m;if(remainder==0L)answer[i]=1};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> divisibilityArray(string word,int m){vector<int> answer(word.size());long long remainder=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)word.size();++i){remainder=(remainder*10+word[i]-'0')%m;if(remainder==0)answer[i]=1;}return answer;} };
